# temps_delivery_profile (Resource)

How traffic reaches apps: `direct` to Temps, or through a CDN (`cloudflare`, `bunny`). Select it for a project with `temps_project_delivery_settings`.

Import with `<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `settings:read`, `settings:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_delivery_profile" "direct" {
  name          = "Direct"
  provider_kind = "direct"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the profile.
- `provider_kind` (String) Delivery path. One of `direct`, `cloudflare`, `bunny`.

### Optional

- `bunny_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Bunny API key (`bunny`). Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `bunny_pull_zone_id` (Number) Bunny pull zone to use (`bunny`).

### Read-Only

- `bunny_hostname` (String) Hostname of the Bunny pull zone.
- `id` (String) Import ID, `<id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id>
terraform import temps_delivery_profile.direct 2
```
